cc:Work.dc:title: Process and surface grids
cc:Work.dc:description: Actual level-3 and level-4 meshes exported from the TypeScript implementation. A highlighted process cell maps to a group of fine cells; a local patch distinguishes primal site edges and circumcentric dual edges.
